{"id":1873359583,"question_id":4177,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"6 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1767458168,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1873359583/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Reverse String Prefix","memory":"9.6 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    string reversePrefix(string s, int k) {\n        if(k == s.size())\n        {\n            reverse(s.begin() , s.end());\n            return s;\n        }\n        \n        string ans = \"\";\n        string rev = s.substr(0 , k);\n        reverse(rev.begin() , rev.end());\n        ans += rev;\n        ans += s.substr(k);\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"reverse-string-prefix","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1447}
